reasons.action: The intent states a new temporal motion — the car pulls forward — so the action is newly authored by the request rather than carried from any observed source.
reasons.medium: With no visual reference attached, the medium decision is no_reference and the rendering medium is fixed by the request/schema rather than by an observed medium.
reasons.wardrobe: There is no visual reference and no observed subject clothing, so nothing is retained; any visible apparel or vehicle dressing is whatever the request implies.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference exists to retain lighting from; the request's own description of the car emerging from darkness is the only lighting content, so the request governs.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale or viewpoint is stated, but with no visual reference there is nothing to inherit framing from, so the request governs; the 16:9 canvas alone does not specify composition.
reasons.palette: No visual reference supplies a scene palette, so the request governs; the darkness described in the intent is the only color/value content available.
